tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// bla ma tshe lha rnam gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel bar tshogs gnyis spel ba'i cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phul byung thugs rje'i 'jug pas srid dang zhi'i// shis rgu'i dngos kun 'jo ba'i rdzogs ldan sprin// bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs kyis// dge legs rtag pa'i me tog char du snyil// gang de'i rnal 'byor zab mo la// brten nas tshogs gnyis spel ba'i thabs// 'chi med grub pa'i dga' ston mchog /skal bzang rnams kyi dpal du sbyin// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ gnas khang bkra shis shing dben la yid dang rjes su mthun par phyag dar legs par byas pa'i gung du dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang*/ khyad par 'chi med tshe lha rnam gsum gyi snang brnyan bris 'bur ji ltar rigs pa bkram pa'i spyan sngar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ bye brag me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnam lnga brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'byor pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal dang tshom bu'i rgyu/ dri chab/ rol mo'i bye brag sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa'o// dang po ni/ nges 'byung dang snying rje'i shugs drag tu bskyed cing dkon mchog gi yon tan yid la byed bzhin pas stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med pa'i gnas lugs la dran pa nye bar bzhag ste/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin rlabs mthu// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang dpal// chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden stobs kyis// snod bcud bde can zhing gi 'byor pa ltar// yid 'phrog ngo mtshar bkod pa 'byams klas gzhir// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cig

/ces bden pa'i stobs dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo d+dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan yid can thams cad 'khod nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rnam gsum la// mi phyed gus pa chen pos skyabs su mchi// zhes ci nus brjod/ gsum pa ni/ 'gro kun srid zhi'i 'jigs las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du bsod nams ye shes kyi// tshogs gnyis spel ba'i cho ga bsgrub par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis smon 'jug gi sems gsal gdab cing*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba/ bzlas pas thugs dam bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs 'od gsal ngang*// zung 'jug ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam rol las// phyi snod dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can// yid 'phrog ngo mtshar bkod pas mdzes pa'i gzhir// rang nyid tha mal gsal ba'i mdun gyi mkhar// phun tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus// pad dkar zla steng rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rnam pa tshe dang ye shes mchog stsol phyir// bcom ldan 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshul// dri med zla ba nor bu'i mtshan dpe la// rab zhi brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i mtshar sdug can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum phyag zhabs kyi// mthil bzhir ye shes spyan res mtshan pa ste// byang chub yan lag bdun gyi gzigs pas mdzes// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin rdzogs ldan sprin chen las// phan dang bde ba'i dngos kun char du 'bebs// g.yon pas dus gsum de bzhin gshegs mtshon pa'i// ut+pal bsnams pas srid zhi'i 'jigs pa 'phrog

/dar dkar stod g.yogs dmar po'i sham thabs dang*// nor bu rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// zla bar rgyab brten rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// de yi spyi bor rigs bdag tshe dpag med// dkar dmar mdangs can mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar dar dang rin chen brgyan// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar rol// gtsug tor las skyes 'od kyi phung po'i dbus// 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma ston zla'i mdog /dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma// zhal rer rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gsum mdzes// phyag g.yas dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// gnyis pas pad dkar la gnas 'od dpag med// gsum pas mda' dang bzhi pas mchog sbyin mdzad// g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang*// gnyis pas gzhu dang gsum pas skyabs sbyin rgya// bzhi pas mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// rnam gsum sku yi cha shas thams cad nas// 'od zer phreng ba dpag g.yas phyogs bcur 'phro// de dag re re'i rtser yang dag pa'i zhing*// rab 'byams rdul gyi grangs snyed snang ba na// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems// tshe la dbang pa'i rig 'dzin drang srong dang*// chos srung nor lha'i tshogs kun sprin ltar gtibs// kun kyang snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku'i// gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las// 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur// ces brjod cing nan tan du gsal gdab/ gnyis pa la bdun las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba la/ thog mar tshogs zhing spyir phyag 'tshal ba ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi// 'char ka'i pad+ma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba// lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas// lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal// zhes phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs rnams gsal btab la/

ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa'i bar gyis phyag bya/ bye brag tu tshogs zhing so sor dmigs nas/ gang gi so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni// dran pas 'chi med mchog stsol tshe yi lhar// yongs shar skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma la// mi phyed snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mar me mdzad sogs rgyal ba 'das pa dang*// byang chub chen po da ltar bzhugs pa dang*// byams pa la sogs slad nas 'byon pa yi// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ma'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan bdun ma// yum gyur ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa// rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs// dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang*// tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la/

thog mar thun mong du/ me tog dam pa sogs nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi sngags brjod/ bye brag nyer spyod sogs kyi mchod pa ni/ dngos su bshams pa nyid rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i yid sprul gyi mchod sprin nam mkha' gang ba khyab cing rtag pa'i tshul du spros te phul bar bsams la/ dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i mchod yon tshogs// bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul// bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dngos su 'byor dang= rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i zhabs bsil tshogs// bla ma 'chi med= /bzhes nas tshe dang= /pā d+yaṃ= /dngos su= /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i me tog tshogs// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /puṣ+pe= dngos su= /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i bdug spos tshogs// bla ma= /bzhes nas= dhū pe= /dngos su= /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i mar me'i tshogs// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /ā lo ke= /dngos su= /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i dri chab tshogs// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /gan+dhe= /dngos su= /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i zhal zas tshogs// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /nai bi d+ye= /dngos su 'byor dang yid las byung ba yi// rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i rol mo'i tshogs// bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul// bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra shap+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i bsod nams kyi// 'byor ba'i khyad par phul byung rin chen bdun// bla ma 'chi med= /bzhes nas tshe dang= /oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sap+ta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rnams// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra pañca kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ dge mtshan bkra shis rtags kyi char 'bebs pa'i// yid 'phrog mchod pa'i lha mo mtha' yas pa// bla ma= /bzhes nas= /oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ tsit+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ stobs bcu mnga' bas byin gyis brlabs pa yi// kun tu shis pa spel ba'i rdzas mchog brgyad// bla ma 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul// bzhes nas tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ dra bya pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ khyad par zhing khams rgya mtsho'i mchod pa ni/ byi dor legs par byas pa'i rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang po'i rlan dang bcas te rin po che dang*/ sman 'bru la sogs pa'i tshom bu dgod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri yi rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu gling*/ nub pa lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ bla ma 'chi med tshe'i lha tshogs/ chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi dge mtshan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ gu ru ā yur de ba ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya stong sogs ci nus dang*/ spro na tshom bu so bdun ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa'ang 'bul/ slar yang yid las byung ba'i mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar spros te don sems bzhin du/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam par gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dang*// ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig

/rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyod kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgom pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man+dā ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'od rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la 'bul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos chus byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'chang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces dang*/ na ma s+sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twe bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro// gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag marnams ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar 'dun pa rtse gcig pas brjod/ spro na spyod 'jug sogs las 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rgyas pa ji ltar rigs pa'ang spel/ gang ltar yang skabs 'dir sems bskyed pa'i go cha blang ba ni thun mong gi tshe sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog gcig tu gsungs pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes dgongs gsol sngon du 'gro bas/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes sems bskyed kyi rten du gyur pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed blang*/

deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// zhes dang*/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron tu bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes dga' ba bsgom/ byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces smon lam gdab bo// de nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma tshe yi lhar// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod cing gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// ces phur tshugs su gsol ba lan grangs mang du btab pa'i mthar/ de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod cing gsol btab dngos grub bsod nams rnam par rgyas pa'i dpal// dbang bcu'i mnga' thang 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// 'chi med srog gi mdud pa dam por bcings// mi shigs tshe yi ljon bzang rab tu brtan// ma 'gags blo dang myur ba'i spobs pa yis// phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs// mthar thugs gsang chen myur lam la brten nas// rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes mngon gyur te// 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i phrin /ces 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gsum pa bzlas pas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ oṃ tā re tut+ta tu re ma ma ā yur puṇ+ye dz+nyān puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes cung zad bzlas mthar/ rtse gcig bsnyen pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros rigs bdag tshe dpag med pa dang*// de yi gtsug tor nor bu'i 'od zer gyis// 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma'i thugs rgyud bskul// kun kyang thugs rje'i 'jug pa lhag par g.yos// dpag yas 'od zer phyogs bcu'i zhing kun khyab// bdag gi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba dang*// 'byung bzhi'i dwangs bcud 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan kun// 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs nas// rigs kyi bdag po'i phyag gi bum par thim// bdud rtsi'i rgyun lud de dang lhan cig tu// tshogs zhing kun gyi sku yi cha shas las// 'chi med grub pa'i zil dngar char ltar babs// rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i sgo nas zhugs// lus kyi nang gang nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs// bla tshe chad nyams yar ba rang sor chud// tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs yon tan rgyas// 'chi med gnyug ma'i go 'phang thob par gyur// ces brjod cing dmigs pa nan tan du gsal btab la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ tshe gzungs/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring thung 'bring po bcas/ sgrol dkar gyi snying po sogs ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurda de swā hā/ zhes rnam rgyal ma'i snying po dang*/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ zhes sgrol dkar gyi snying po dang*/ skabs su spel tshig dang bcas pa'ang ci nus su bzla zhing*/ spro na tshe dpag med pa'i gzungs mdo/ rnam rgyal ma'i rtog pa/ sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig rnams kyang bklag par bya ste/ sangs rgyas rjes dran du byas nas klog par gsungs pa'i don yin pas shin tu legs/

po'i rnam thar las byung ba// sangs rgyas zhing mthar khyab pas rtag tu mchod// ces dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzung brjod/ bdag gzhan 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i// sdig ltung kun bshags dge la son// nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis gting nas 'byongs// rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod la dbang bsgyur nas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// khyad par nad gdon sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe sogs// dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs ye shes dang*// phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// mthar thug gsang chen myur lam la brten nas// rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes mngon gyur te// 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i phrin las kyis// mkha' khyab 'gro kun 'dren par byin rlobs// gzhan yang bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa rnams// bskal brgyar zhabs brtan chos 'khor bskor ba dang*// bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa yis// sa gsum dge legs 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs// bkra shis srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan gyi// dge mtshan snang ba nub pa med pa'i phul// phun tshogs 'chi med grub pa'i ngo mtshar dang*// lhan cig phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas gyur cig

/ces gsol pa gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ tshogs zhing thams cad 'od zhu rang la thim// rang gi sgo gsum gnyug ma'i ye shes dang*// skyabs yul rnams kyi gsang gsum dbyer med ngang*// gnas lugs 'od gsal chos sku'i rang zhal blta// zhes brjod cing bsams la gnas lugs de kho na nyid kyi dbyings su mnyam par gzhag gsum pa ni/ de las ldang bar brtsam pa na/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan// phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas// tshe dpag med mgon go 'phang myur thog shog /ces dang*/ spro na/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi// zhes sogs bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gdab/ che ba'i che mchog sogs mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i bkra shis dang*/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam dpyod shes rab dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig 'grogs// sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan// ja bzang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad// skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod cing me tog gi char sil mar bsnyil bas dge legs su bya'o// bsgrub bya gzhan gyi ched du byed pa'i tshe/ bla ma sogs yul mchog rnams rang gi g.yas phyogs su rin po che'i khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du bzhugs pa dang*/ sbyin bdag phal pa'i rigs rnams mdun du 'khod pa/ de dag kyang lang tsho dar la babs shing gos rgyan gzabs mchor phun sum tshogs par gsal btab la tshe bcud bsdu bstim lhan cig tu bgyis pas don grub pa yin no// de ltar 'bad pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe dpag med kyi gzungs mdo dang*/ gtsug tor rnams rgyal ma'i rtog pa dang*/ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi phan yon sogs las ji skad gsung pa ltar sdig pa dang sgrib thams cad byang zhing*/

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes la sogs pa legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ tshe 'phos nas kyang dag pa'i zhing khams bde ba can du skyes nas myur du byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'thob pa sogs srid pa dang zhi ba'i dge mtshan mtha' dag gis 'byor par 'gyur pa ni nges pa'o// rtag par gzhan la sman 'dod pa'i// yid kyi chu gter nyams dga' ba// sangs rgyas byin rlabs mthus bskul bas// 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs 'di byung*// de las 'thob pa'i dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i sprin// byang chub snying po'i pha 'khor lo dus rtag tu bskor ba dang*/ rang gzhan yid can mtha' dag tshe dang bsod nams ye shes kyi dge mtshan rgyas pa'i rten 'byung du dmigs te 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i rgya gar skad du/ a pa ri mi tā yu raṃ sto traṃ/ bod skad du/ tshe dpag med la bstod pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor// sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun// ma lus par ni sel mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// rdo rje sems dpa' las byung zhing*// nyes pa'i dri ma kun bcom pa// rdo rje'i lus can rdo rje can// rdo rje tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// bsam pa'i don kun skad cig gis// rang 'dod bzhin du tshim mdzad dpal// mchog gi bdag po chen po ste// rin chen tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis// kun nas gos par mi 'gyur zhing*// thugs rjes chags tshul ston mdzad pa'i// pad+ma tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// 'dod pa'i las rnams ma lus pa// skad cig nyid kyis rdzogs pa'i dpal// bsam kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing*// las kyi tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// nyes pa kun las khyod grol nas// sna tshogs yon tan kun gyis brgyan// 'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste// kun gzigs tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te// mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus 'joms// ston pa sred med bu yi stobs// yon tan tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa'i// ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin pa// rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs// ye shes tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// rnam par rtog las khyod grol nas// mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba ste// bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa'i// mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung*// khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la// tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i// tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa'o// 'chi med mgon po'i lha tshogs la// gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod pa'i mthus// bdag gi rgyud la nges 'byung dang*// byang chub sems gnyis rgyas gyur cig

/tshogs zung chu gter las 'khrungs pa'i// tshe mtha' yas pa'i lha sngags dang*// ting 'dzin snang bas grub gnyis kyi// pad+mo mchog tu rgyas par shog /rnam snang rdo rje rin chen dang*// pad+mo las rigs ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur ba'i// skal bzang lhag par grub gyur cig /skye kun dug lngas bsags pa yi// 'tsho ba thung ba'i sgrib byang nas// rigs lnga tshe dpag med mgon gyi// go 'phang rgyud la 'jog par shog /kun gzigs yon tan ye shes dang*// mi g.yo'i rang bzhin zil dngar gyis// 'gal rkyen bkru zhing byang ba dang*// rdo rje'i srung ba mchog gyur cig /bdag gi snying dbus pad+mo dang*// spyi bor bzhugs pa'i ye shes lha// bde 'thung bcud du zhu ba yis// lus sems 'chi med grub par shog /rin chen bdun dang rdzas brgyad sogs// srid zhi'i 'byor pas dge byas mthus// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// bkra shis snang ba 'bar gyur cig /mdor na 'di nas byang chub bar// dpag med mgon pos rjes bzung nas// tshe dang bsod nams ye shes kyi// grub gnyis dge mtshan 'phel bar shog /ces pa'i 'dod gsol smon tshig 'di'ang gzhung dang mthun par 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa tī uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza yī sto traṃ/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod pa/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma ni// puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i me tog ltar// skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhal gsum phyag brgyad spyan gsum mnga'// dbu rgyan mgul rgyan snyan char bcas// rin chen sna tshogs mdzes par brgyan// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs// dbus dkar g.yas ser g.yon zhal sngo// khro mo'i cha lugs mche ba gtsigs// phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// pad steng rgyal po 'od dpag med// mda' dang mchog sbyin phyag rgya'o// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang*// gzhu dang mi 'jigs phyag rgya dang*// bum pa dag ni legs par bsnams// rnam par snang mdzad dbu brgyan cing*// 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du// stod g.yogs lha yi na bza' can// blo dang tshe 'phel mdzad pa mo// pu ri'i nang du mdzes par bzhugs// bcom ldan 'das ma nyid la bstod// g.yas na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po skyon ma gos// g.yon na pad bsnams g.yas pa na// rnga yab 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// g.yon gyi gsang ba'i bdag po ni// ut+pal mdog 'dra rdo rje g.yon// g.yas pa rnga yab mdzes 'dzin pa// mthu stobs can la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi yi// khro bo'i rgyal po bzhi po ni// mdun na khro rgyal mi g.yo ba// sngo bsangs g.yas na ral gri 'dzin// g.yon na sdigs mdzub skra brdzes pa// sbrul rgyan stag gi sham thabs can// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// ma rungs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po ni// sngo bsangs lcags kyu 'bar ba bsnams// ma rungs 'dul ba'i rgyan cha can// thams cad 'gugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khro chen dbyug pa sngon po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa ni// dbyug to g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// sngo bsangs kun 'dul khyod la bstod// khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che// ut+pal mdog 'dra phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pa rdo rje sdigs mdzub g.yon// bdud 'dul drag po khyod la bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo// kun kyang stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// bar chad zhi mdzad khyed la bstod// steng gi phyogs na mdzes pa yi// gnas gtsang lha yi bu gnyis po// lha yi rgyan dang na bzas mdzes// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs kun la snyoms// dag pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gang zhig nangs nas sngar langs te// bstod pa'i 'di yis dus kun tu// 'khor dang bcas la bstod gyur na// blo dang tshe rnams 'phel ba dang*// dpal dang 'byor ba'i dngos grub ster// mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur// gus pa'i sems kyis sngar langs nas// rtse gcig sems kyis bstod par bya// gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bstod pa/

slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā tā rā sto traṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la bstod pa/ oṃ/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol mar phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'chi med grub pa'i slob dpon chen po ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa'i 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa'i mngon rtogs bstod par kha bsgyur ba'o// glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma// dpa' mo tā re tut+tā re// sangs rgyas zhal gyi pad+ma yi// ge sar las byung khyod la 'dud// ston ka'i zla ba rgyas pa yi// dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs zhal mnga' ma// mchog sbyin phyag rgyas ut+pa la// bsnams ma khyed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i gzeb las tut+tā re// swā hās nyon mongs zhi bar mdzad// oṃ gyi ngo bo nyid kyis ni// tshangs pa'i sgo 'byed ma la 'dud// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad rnams las// 'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad// kun gyi mar gyur bcom ldan 'das// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'ang ngag dbang grags pas mdzad/ ༈ /'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang*// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// 'phags ma khyed la dad byed pa// de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs// bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsol// lha mo sku mdog zla 'dra'i mdog

/sgeg cing dul ba'i cha byad can// gzugs ldan rin chen rgyan gyis spras// mdzes pa dar gyi smad g.yogs can// pad+ma zla ba'i dbus gnas su// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung mdzad// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bag can// dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum// lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud// khyed la cha tsam bstod pa yis// bdag cag byang chub bsgrub pa la// dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar// mi mthun rkyen rnams zhi gyur te// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par shog /'dod gsol 'di 'brom ston pa'i gsung byin rlabs can yin par yongs su grags so// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la bstod pa 'chi med zla gzhon gsar pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ ta thā ga tā pa ri mi tā yur+dz+nyā na su bi ni sh+tsit+ta te dzo rādz+nye sto traṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zag med ye shes dam pa'i snod gyur ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i 'jo sgeg can// gdul bya'i dbang por 'tshams par 'jug pa'i gsung gsang brjod bral nā da'i dbyangs// spros pa'i mtha' dang mdza' ba ma yin rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan thugs// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor dgyes rol bde ldan zhing gtso tshe mtha' yas// gang mtshan nor bu'i do shal g.yo ba lus can bsod nams rna lung du// dpyangs pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal gsum gyi mya ngan grong las dbugs 'byin nas// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes mchog gi 'dod don ci dgar 'jo ba yis// re ba'i shing rta phyur bur 'gengs phyir su zhig rab tu bstod mi byed// chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam dag bden smon sprin dkar me tog 'jo ba las// gnas ngan len gyi rdul dang mi mdza' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag

/brgyad cu rtsa gcig sangs rgyas zhing bkod yon tan gcig bsdoms za ma tog /dag pa rab 'byams dga' tshal dam par phul byung bsngags 'os brjod me long*// shin tu gzhon sha chags pa'i lag mthil dzam+bu nā das mdangs pa'i dbyig /gang gi gzhir chags ut+pal gyis bsrungs mnan nem bteg 'phar sa 'dzin ngos// yan lag brgyad ldan ca co rnam spangs zhi bsil bden gnyis chos kyi sgras// kun rmongs ma rig gnyid las sad mdzad dbang 'thung chu gter g.yo ba'i 'gram// baiḍūr+ya dang in+d+ra nī la shel dang margad la sogs pa'i// rin chen sna tshogs man+dā ra ba yid 'ong g.yo ba'i bar bar nas// gser gyi drwa bas rnam par sbrel gyur dri bzhon pho nyas bskul ba las// mnyan par 'os pa'i sgra dbyangs zad med chog mi shes par kun tu sgrogs// de dag rnams kyi yal 'dab gzhon nus bsti stang byas pa'i do kar rtser// shin tu rab sgeg ngang tshul zhi zhing phan tshun rtse ba'i sha ku naḥ /gtsug phud mdangs can margad gshog ldan mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol la sogs// sna tshogs shing rta'i glu dbyangs las lhag rab snyan rol mos yongs su bkang*// de na thun mtshams 'da' ba ma yin khor yug 'od snang phreng bas gtams// mchog tu mdzes pa'i dga' tshal las byung 'dod pa'i yon tan gzhal dka' ba// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bkod pas mi bskrun phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba cher// ngoms pa med par longs su spyod phyir mtshan gyi spring yig rnam par gsal// mdor na kun mkhyen ye shes kyis sbyangs dag pa'i rdul bral spyan rnon pos// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtshor btsal kyang mtshungs zlas dben par rab gzigs nas// mchog tu bsngags pa'i sprin gyi me tog rmad byung 'jo ba'i ngo mtshar khur// nor 'dzin bu mos theg par dka' ba'i dogs pas ring du 'dar ba bzhin// gang na rin chen sna tshogs pha gus rnam par brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'chi med grub pa'i grong khyer las lhag byang chub phyogs chos yongs rdzogs dbus// mdangs ldan gzhon nu'i rol sgeg gis bsten nor bu'i ba gam g.yo ba'i khrir// lo 'dab gos bzang mngon par 'dzin pa'i chu skyes gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng gis// thig le mchog ma'i lang tsho sma dbab lta na sdug de'i dpal 'phrog phyir// pad+ma'i rtsa lag kun+dā'i bshes zung do zlar lhags pa'i de ma thag

/gang gi zhal bzang lta bas mi ngoms 'od zer brgya phrag g.yo ba'i dpal// cha las tsam yang bzod par ma nus zhabs mthil 'khor lor yibs pa bzhin// bye ru'i lhun po nyi gzhon 'char ka'i drwa bas mdzes pa'i lang tsho ltar// kun tu rab dmar gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor mthong na mi mthun bral ba der// mtshan dpe'i 'jo sgeg gsar pas 'khyud gyur 'od zer dpag med phreng ba yis// phyogs bcu'i khyon kun yongs su rab 'gengs sgrib pa'i mun pa rnam par bcom// thal mo'i ut+pal dmar po phan tshun mnyam gzhag gis sbrel chu skyes sbubs// sna tshogs dar gyi lo 'dab rab g.yo pad+ma rā ga'i ka la sha /srid zhi'i bcud bsdus 'chi med chu gter ring 'tsho'i zla shel 'dzum dkar can// 'gro kun tshe yi ku mu dā dpal yid 'ong dbye ba'i byed por grub// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ban+dhu dzī ba'i 'dab brgyad dgod pa'i spyan ras zung*// kun nas dkyus ring rtag tu 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i rol sgeg can// dbu skyes mthon mthing ut+pal gzhon nu sna tshogs rin chen drwa ba yis// rnam par bcings byas ral pa'i gdengs ka dgos 'byung nor bu'i rgyan gyis spud// dbang po'i gzhu ltar kha dog yid 'ong lcid kyis non spangs reg bya yi// stod g.yogs smad dkris mdzes par 'chang zhing do shal dpung rgyan gdu bu sogs// rin thang bral ba'i rat+na'i rgyan dang me tog phreng ba'i tshangs skud rnams// byang chub yan lag bdun gyi mtshon byed gang sku'i gsang bar yongs su 'dzin// de ni mtha' gcig kho na nyid mod gzhan du tshogs gnyis chu gter che// bskal par goms pa'i man+dā ras bsrubs zag bral zla ba'i lang tsho la// skye dang 'bri sogs don la med kyang snang tshul rnam mang sprul pa'i gar// nyan rang so skye'i blo las 'das der rab gus ku mud 'dzum phreng dgod// gsung gi gsang ba mchog tu mi 'gyur sgra dang sgra mig rnam dpyad las// yongs su brgal yang tha dad rtog pa'i rjes su 'gro ba'i nā da'i dbyangs// yan lag drug cu'i 'jo sgeg gis 'khyud bden gnyis chos tshul rgya mtsho yis// thar pa mchog gi go 'phang la sbyor 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci la 'dud// rtag chad gdon dang mdza' ba ma yin spros pa kun bral de bzhin nyid// gcig bu nyid min du ma las 'das bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes ni// so so yang dag rig pa'i rang bzhin ji lta ji snyed mkhyen dang brtse'i// thugs rje'i rnam rol bri gang med par lhun gyis grub pa mchog la 'dud// phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs gaṅgā'i bye snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// khyod kyi spangs rtogs rjes su bsngags pa'i rol mo rnam par 'khrol ba dang*// mig mi 'dzum dang gsang ba 'dzin sogs byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog gis// spyi bos zhabs mthil 'khor lo la btud yon tan dpag yas de la 'dud// 'di na sna tshogs las kyi phyi bzhin rnam par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba kun// sgrib gnyis nyon mongs ling tog gis ldong thar pa'i lam las phyir phyogs par// brtse chen thugs rje'i zhags pas 'dzin phyir sna tshogs sprul ba'i zlos gar ni// sems can khams dang mthun par 'jug pa'i phrin las mchog mnga' khyod la 'dud// de ltar gser gyi mngal can blos kyang gzhal bar mi nus yon tan phul// zla bas 'phel ba'i gting las rab zab kun gsal khams las rgya che ba'i// rnam par thar pas so skye'i yid ngor cha shas phra ba'ang mi mthong mod// 'dir ni rtag tu dad pa'i dbang gyur bstod tshig rol mo gsar pas mchod// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dri bzhon dga' ma dal bur g.yo ba'i 'jo sgeg gis// kun nas mkhyen pa'i ye shes che ldan thugs rje'i sprin dkar la 'khyud pas// rjes su brtse ba'i snying rje'i dbang gyur glog phreng do shal g.yo ba dang*// lhan cig bdag blo'i chu skyes mdzes par phan bde'i bdud rtsis brlan gyur cig

/gnas skabs gang mtshan dpal gyi dum bu'i bsil ngad las lhag zla gzhon zer// brgyad gnyis 'jigs pa'i tsha gdung gis nyen sa yi gdu bu la rtsen pas// mi mthun tshogs kun yongs su bcom ste mtho ris yon tan bdun la sogs// legs tshogs 'dab ma'i 'dzum phreng grol bas kun yid dga' ba sbyin gyur cig /khyad par srid dang zhi bar yongs khyab ring 'tsho'i chu gter 'phyur ba nyid// khyod sku'i 'od zer rnam par g.yo ba'i man+dā ra yis bsrubs pa las// phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i snang bas rab mdzes 'chi med grub pa'i kar+pūr dbang*// rab tu gus pas bstod pa lhur len skal bzang bde 'byung ral rtser stsol// de mthus 'tsho ba'i 'khri shing yid 'ong g.yo med gcig tu btsugs pa'i mod// mi bgres lang tsho'i me tog 'dzum dkar thar pa nyin mo'i phyogs su grol// lung rtogs 'bras bzang khur gyis rab dud lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro kun la// dga' dang gtan bde'i nor gyis tshim byed yon tan mchog gis lci bar shog /gang sku yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i rlabs phreng lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams bcas// rtag tu gsal btab gsang sngags mchog bzlas zab mo'i ting 'dzin la gzhol tshe// dpag med 'dren pa kun gyi 'khor bcas bye ru'i zhal bzang g.yo ba'i rdul// mngon sum mig gi bdud rtsir btung bas don gnyis lang tsho rgyas gyur cig /gzhan yang thos bsam sgom pa'i chu gter rlabs chen 'phyur ba las thon pa'i// rtsod 'chad rtsom sogs lung rtogs chos tshul 'od zer 'bum phrag bzhu pa'i rdul// 'khor lo gsum ldan dge 'dun 'dus pa'i blo mchog spobs pas bzung ba las// rgyal bstan rin chen pad+ma'i dga' tshal dar babs g.yo ba'i rgyud gyur cig /shin tu dben pa'i nags kyi spyil por ku sha 'jam po'i gdan gyi steng*// dag byed khrus btung dka' thub la gnas drang srong chen po'i ngang tshul ltar// gcig tu nges 'byung sems kyis rab bskul thar pa don du gnyer rnams kyi// sbyangs pa'i yon tan cha shas kun gang nges legs them skas la 'dzeg shog

/nam zhig bdag gzhan 'dir snang rdzogs te srog gi dbang po sdud pa'i tshe// mgon po gang gis dgyes pa'i phyag gis 'khor ba'i g.yang sa las drangs te// yon tan bkod pa gzhal gyis mi long dag pa'i zhing der pad+mo'i sbubs// mtshan dpe'i lus mchog rnam par 'dzin nas khyod zhabs rtag tu bsnyen par shog /de ltar bstod bsngags 'od zer phreng ldan zla shel myu gu gsar pa'i gzugs// shin tu gus pa'i bde 'byung ral rtser bral thob spangs par son pa las// tshe bsod dpal 'byor ku mud 'dzum dkar yid 'ong bye ba'i de ma thag /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ge sar rtag tu lci ba thob par 'gyur// de ltar bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'chi med zla gzhon gsar pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa rten dang brten par bcas pa dang mthun zhing mngon rtogs dag gi don dang yang mi 'gal bar gzhon nu a bha yas rang lo bco brgyad par bṛ ṣa bha zhes khyu mchog zla ba'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i gral tshes dge bar yongs su grub par bgyis pa'i dge bas gnas skabs lus can thams cad sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu gter las bsgral nas mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer du dbugs 'byin thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal la bstod pa 'chi med grub pa sprin gyi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza yī sto dre nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gtsug tor rnam rgyal la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// blo ldan gang zhig mtshan tsam 'dzin nam 'on te thos pa dag gis kyang*// sna tshogs 'jigs ster sdug bsngal tshogs kun nye bar bcom pa'i de ma thag /'chi med tshe dang rga na rgud pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrog lang tsho'i stobs// dad dang shes rab bsod nams 'byor pa mngon du stsol mdzad de bstod bya// gzod ma nyid nas bskal pa du mar tshogs gnyis chu gter bsrubs pa las// thar pa mchog gi cha shas yongs gang byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi// ri dwags gzhon nu'i rtags kyis mngon rol bde gshegs chos sku'i rten mchog gi// gzhal yas khang chen mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba de la 'dud// de dbus char sprin dkar po'i bar bar ut+pal dmar pos mdangs pa bzhin// srab 'jam mnyen lcug mchog tu yid 'ong 'dab stong rgyas pa'i chu skyes rtser// brgyad gnyis cha ldan rnyog pa'i ra ri kun nas bral ba'i dpal de yis// khyod zhabs 'khor lo'i re khās mtshan pa nye bar bsten pa de la 'dud// gang sku ston zla cha rdzogs 'od zer brgya stong brtsegs pa'i dpal ltar gsal// spyan gyi ge sar rnam par mdzes ldan 'gro la rjes su brtse ba'i gzugs// gnag snum ral pa'i chun po g.yo ba puṇ+ḍa rī kas rnam bcings rtser// chos dbyings ye shes mtshan dpe'i zlos gar rigs kyi bdag po 'dzin der 'dud// rtsa ba'i zhal ni chu shel ji bzhin g.yas pa dzam bu'i gser gyi mdog

/cig shos in+d+ra nī la'i 'od ltar kun tu sngo ba'i gzi brjid kyis// log 'dren tshogs kun rnam par 'ching ba'i zhags pa nyid do de ldog pa'i// yon tan ma lus mngon du 'gugs byed dbang gi mchil pa rnon po'ang lags// rnam par thar pa gsum dang ldan pa'i spyan gyi ye shes me bo yis// sdug bsngal gsum gyi gcong rong gting zab 'khor ba'i tshang tshing bsregs nas slar// dus gsum kun tu ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes snang ba des// khams gsum 'dzin pa'i rab rmongs mun pa yongs su bsal mdzad de la 'dud// phyag gi dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi g.yas par phrin las bzhi ster rdo rje dang*// pad+ma dkar po'i zhabs mthil mngon bsten bcom ldan 'od snang mtha' yas che// dus ma yin pa'i nye bu'i snying 'bigs myur du 'gro ba'i mtshon cha'i dpal// thar pa'i dpal kun yongs su ster byed mchog sbyin phyag rgyas mdzes der 'dud// gcig shos dang por bgegs kyi tshogs kun gzir dang 'gugs pa'i sdigs mdzub bzhag /snying rje chen pos 'gro kun sdud mdzad shes rab mchog gi rat+na'i gzhu// skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dbugs 'byin thar pa'i dpal ster mi 'jigs rgya// las dang nyon mongs sgrib gnyis 'khrud mdzad 'dud rtsi'i bum bzang 'dzin der 'dud// brten pa med par mkha' dbyings la shar dbang po'i gzhu yi zhun ma yis// kha dog bsgyur 'dra'i lha rdzas reg bya lcid kyis spangs pa'i sham thabs dang*// ga bur 'dzin pa'i tshon gyis mngon bsgyur stod g.yogs gsar pas mdzes byas shing*// yan lag 'khri shing rin chen drwa ba'i rgyan gyis kun tu spras la 'dun// 'khor gyi tshogs ni snying rje'i gter 'dzin 'phags pa mchog dang gsang ba'i bdag /bsdu dngos bzhi yi rang bzhin las skyes nyon mongs bdud dgra kun bcom pa'i// mi g.yo mgon dang 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyugs sngon bzung dang stobs po che// me tog phreng 'dzin gtsang ris lha bu gzhon nu gnyis bcas kun la 'dud// gang zhig kun du nye bar rab zhi gdod nas rnam dag ye shes ni// sna tshogs gzung 'dzin spros pa kun bral 'od gsal dbu ma'i chos nyid can// 'pho 'gyur med bzhin gang 'dul mdzad pa lhun gyis grub par rtag 'jug pa'i// zag bral mchog gi yon tan gyis dgyes gtsug tor chos kyi sku la 'dud// smon lam stobs kyis mngon par skyed bsrings dpag yas dag pa'i zhing khams su// rmad byung tshogs gnyis byed pos rab bskrun mtshan dpe'i 'od zer drwa ba yis// khrag khrig bdud kyi mun pa pham bgyid gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang*// rjes su mthun par dga' bas tshims mdzad gtsug tor longs spyod rdzogs la 'dud// 'gro 'di'i kun rtog rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin tha dad bar med mngon 'phyo ba// rga na 'chi dang skye ba la sogs sdug bsngal 'dzin khri'i grong khyer can// de las sna tshogs thabs tshul du ma'i mdzad pa dpag yas rin chen grus// zhi bde thar pa'i gling du 'dren mdzad gtsug tor sprul pa'i sku la 'dud// 'od snang mtha' yas tshe dpag med mgon gtsug tor gdengs ka'i chu gter las// thabs dang shes rab mi phyed 'dres gyur thugs rje chen po'i zla shel dbang*// mngon par 'thon gang phan dang bde ba'i 'dzum zer gsar ba'i 'jo sgeg gis// srid pa'i mun nag phung por rnam rgyal zhi ba'i ku mud bzhad der 'dud// gang gsung sgra dang tshig gis mi mtshon lung rtogs char sprin rol mo ni// skal bzang gnyis skyes rna ba'i bcud len rtag par sbyin pa'i de ma thag

/byang chub spyod pa'i sgro gshog zlum pos grub gnyis rol gar bsgyur ba dang*// lhan cig rnam grol mchog gi mnga' khur mngon par 'dzin mdzad de la 'dud// khyod ni 'jig rten gsum gyi thor tshugs rin chen drwa bas spa ba der// zhabs mthil bkod la ngo mtshar ci zhig de kun 'dren pa'i rgyal ba yis// thugs rje skul mdzad ye shes rab skyed yum gyur shes rab phar phyin dang*// gnyis su ma yin mnyam par bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar mchog der bstod par bgyi// rtag tu mi 'bral ting 'dzin byed pos khyod sku rab mdzes lhun stug pa// yid kyi thig ler ro gcig bkod cing grags stong gsang sngags rol mo ni// mgrin pa'i rgyan du bar med 'khrol bas dgyes pa'i spyan zur g.yo ba'i 'od// gus pa chen po'i chu skyes rtser son dge mtshan 'dab brgya dgod par shog /brtan g.yo'i 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma kun dang phun tshogs ring 'tsho'i zil dngar gyis// srog gi mdud pa dam por bcings gyur lha dang drang srong grub pa'i sde// skye sogs brgal dka'i pha mthar son pa'i sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i dpal// kun nas bsdus te rnal 'byor la brtson skal bzang 'gro la rgya cher stsol// de mthus mi bgres lang tsho'i stobs kyis gnyis 'thung dbang po zil gnon zhing*// bsrubs skyes bdud rtsi'i bcud len grub bzhin bskal par mi shigs rdo rje'i srog /tshe grangs med par kun nas thob pa'i lha yi tshal skyes go bi dā// bsod nams ye shes lo 'dab rab g.yo mchog gi 'bras bu 'dzin par shog /khyad par dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs ster sha za khros pa'i gdong ba lta'i// nad kyis 'tshe dang rgyal po'i chad pa gcan gzan chu gter 'khrugs pa'i rlabs// chom kun brang 'gro seng ge khros dang gnyis 'thung la sogs gdug pa'i rkyen// thugs brtse'i shugs kyis myur du bcom nas bde ba'i go sar son gyur cig

/lam gsum 'gro bas rtag par bkrus kyang cung zad dag pa'i skabs bral zhing*// lha yi dbang po'i lag na nyal ba'i rdo rje'i mtshon gyis brdar bas min// shin tu gnag pa'i las kyi mun pas mtha' med 'khor bar 'phyan gyur gang*// khyod zhal dran cing rig sngags bzlas pa'i zla ba'i zegs mas myur bcom mdzod// sngon byung skabs gsum grong khyer la rtsen shin tu brtan pa dus min gyi// 'chi dang las kyis sdug bsngal phung por mngon par 'jug thos de yi tshe// kun nas gdung ba'i sprin bzhon bskul te bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba'i mod// khyod kyi rig sngags bstan nas zhi bzhin bdag kyang de 'drar mdzad du gsol// 'di na pad+ma gzhon sha chags pas 'gram pa'i 'jo sgeg bsten byas pa'i// ri dwags tshogs rnams nags na rol bzhin rnal 'byor la brtson 'khor bcas kyang*// bas mtha'i gnas mchog shin tu nyams dgar shing shun 'jam po'i khang bzang dbus// sbyangs yon bcu gnyis tshul bzhin spyod nas srog gi lhag ma don ldan shog /stong nyid snying rje'i shing rta'i dbang gyur khyod zhabs pad+ma'i rtsa lag gis// brgyad gnyis 'jigs pa'i mun pa rab zhi rig pa'i blo dang bsod nams dpal// dad nor gtong sogs yon tan bdun ldan ut+pal gzhon nu nyer rgyu shing*// legs tshogs dbang gyur tshul min ku mud kun nas kun tu zum par mdzod// nam zhig 'dir snang nub par gyur tshe gang gi thugs rje'i phyag sor gyis// dgyes par bzung nas nyam nga'i 'phrang las dbugs 'byin stsol ba'i de ma thag /chu skyes gzhon nu'i mngal las grol ba'i dag pa'i lus mchog 'dzin pa'i mod// tshe dang ye shes 'od zer dpag med mgon po de yi zhal mthong shog /de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab cing lus kyi ba spu'i 'khri shing g.yo// ngag gi gdung dbyangs mgrin par brtsegs nas yid kyis nyin mtshan bar med du// 'phags ma gang gi yon tan la dad bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di bklags pas// ji skad gsungs pa'i don rnams grub ste skal pa bzang ldan skye bor 'gyur// de ltar 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma la bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa 'chi med grub pa sprin gyi rol mo 'di ni rang gzhan gyi don du nye bar dmigs te blo gsal a bha yas rang lo bcu bdun par rig grol phun tshogs gling du legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang bla na med pa'i dge mtshan dam pa rmad du byung ba 'byung bar gyur cig/
